asked.item: Why the code gave "Invalid or expired token"
What to do now after the code came an hour later

verdict.reason: The transfer FAQ explains that codes expire in about 15 minutes, what the error means, and how to get a fresh code.

steps.text: An "Invalid or expired token" error during this flow means the code was entered in the wrong session or after it expired.
Request a fresh code at my.blotato.com/login and use it immediately.
Redo the transfer steps from your original browser, and enter the code in the session that started the change, not on the new owner's device.
